name: Embers of Hollowmere
author: OpenGate starter campaign
description: The dead will not stay buried in the market town of Hollowmere. One town, one camp, one barrow and five missions: a short adventure for 1st-level heroes that shows off every system in the framework.

do.sub: A market town at the edge of the mere

_voices_doc: speaker id -> ElevenLabs voice id (pre-made voices). List yours with: npm run voices -- hollowmere --voices
portraitStyle: Painted fantasy character portrait, head and shoulders, three-quarter view, looking toward the viewer, dramatic warm rim light against a dark muted background, rich painterly brushwork in the style of classic computer role-playing game character portraits. Tasteful and fully clothed. No text, no letters, no frame, no border.

town.prompt: Calm medieval town at dusk, solo lute and soft wooden flute, a little melancholy, gentle and unhurried, seamless loop, instrumental

camp.prompt: Quiet night campfire music, sparse acoustic guitar and low strings, peaceful and reflective, seamless loop, instrumental

barrow.prompt: Dark ambient dungeon crypt, low drones, distant choir and slow deep drum, tense and ominous, seamless loop, instrumental
